meta.purpose: #284 名單身份佐證 fixture：官方 E 名單 64 人＋同名他人＋2026 兩隊 team_roster；只含鍵欄
meta.source: 本機共享 cpbl（localhost:5433）READ ONLY 交易匯出

queries.team_roster: SELECT year, team_code, player_id, name FROM cpbl.team_roster WHERE year = 2026 AND team_code = ANY(%s) ORDER BY team_code, player_id
queries.players: SELECT id, name, country FROM cpbl.players WHERE id = ANY(%s) ORDER BY id
queries.games: SELECT year, kind_code, game_season_code, game_sno, home_team_code, away_team_code FROM cpbl.games WHERE year = 2026 AND kind_code = 'A' AND (home_team_code = ANY(%s) OR away_team_code = ANY(%s)) ORDER BY game_sno
queries.batting_gamelog: SELECT year, kind_code, game_sno, hitter_acnt, visiting_home_type FROM cpbl.batting_gamelog WHERE year = 2026 AND kind_code = 'A' AND hitter_acnt = ANY(%s) AND game_sno = ANY(%s) ORDER BY game_sno, hitter_acnt
queries.pitching_gamelog: SELECT year, kind_code, game_sno, pitcher_acnt, visiting_home_type FROM cpbl.pitching_gamelog WHERE year = 2026 AND kind_code = 'A' AND pitcher_acnt = ANY(%s) AND game_sno = ANY(%s) ORDER BY game_sno, pitcher_acnt
